2608.31167.title: SUN: Persistent Programs For Language-Grounded Control-to-Learning-to-Real Policies
2608.31167.paper_summary: Bridging model-based control and learned policies in long-horizon manipulation has harbored a silent disagreement: control executes specified objectives, learning amortizes that behavior into a reactive policy, yet existing protocols discard task semantics, leaving rewards hand-crafted and behavior drifting from what control verified.We introduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables where geometric and contact relations are defined once and compiled into aligned Model Predictive Control (MPC) costs, satisfaction predicates, RL rewards, transition guards, and diagnostics. Our system, Kuafu, driven by large vision language systems, automatically synthesizes SUN Programs from language and scene semantics, screens feasibility via MPC, and retains semantics while training stage-conditioned policies. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success, outperforming sparse-reward (35.67%) and Stage-BC (24.75%) baselines. At 8192-way scale, it generates 10.57x the successful trajectory time per hour of human teleoperation. With 500 trajectories per task, Kuafu data trains DP3 policies to 46.0% simulation success (vs. 22.4% for alternatives) and 34.7% on physical Franka and Kinova robots. These results establish that simulation-screened task semantics can effectively amortize control into robust policies, without demonstrations or manual dense rewards, unifying symbolic planning and data-driven execution.
2608.31167.paper_summary_zh: 在長期操作中，模型基礎控制與學習策略之間存在著一種默默的分歧：控制執行指定的目標，學習將該行為轉化為反應式策略，但現有的協議卻忽略了任務語義，導致獎勵是手工製作的，行為與控制所驗證的內容逐漸偏離。我們引入了語義統一（SUN）程序，這是一種類型化的可執行文件，其中幾何和接觸關係被定義一次並編譯成對齊的模型預測控制（MPC）成本、滿意度謂詞、強化學習獎勵、轉換保護和診斷。我們的系統Kuafu，受大型視覺語言系統驅動，能夠自動從語言和場景語義合成SUN程序，通過MPC篩選可行性，並在訓練階段條件策略時保留語義。在九個任務中，Kuafu實現了82.03%的宏觀成功率，優於稀疏獎勵（35.67%）和階段BC（24.75%）基準。在8192路徑規模下，它每小時生成10.57倍的成功軌跡時間，超過人類遠程操作。每個任務500條軌跡，Kuafu數據訓練DP3策略達到46.0%的模擬成功率（相比之下，其他方法為22.4%），在物理Franka和Kinova機器人上達到34.7%。這些結果證明，經過模擬篩選的任務語義可以有效地將控制轉化為穩健的策略，而無需示範或手動密集獎勵，實現符號規劃與數據驅動執行的統一。
